memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: 'If someone dies suddenly in the Nazirite's presence, thus defiling the hair they have dedicated, they must shave their head on the day of their cleansing—the seventh day. Then on the eighth day they must bring two doves or two young pigeons to the priest at the entrance to the tent of meeting. The priest is to offer one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering to make atonement for the Nazirite because they sinned by being in the presence of the dead.' - Num 6:9-11 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
What happened if, through no fault of their own, someone suddenly died beside the Nazirite and interrupted their vow? God, in His grace, made provision for it. There was a way to be cleansed, to make atonement, and to begin again.

This is deeply comforting. Even when a person's consecration was broken — even by an accident they could not control — God did not simply cast them off. He provided a path back through sacrifice and cleansing. There was always a way to be restored.

How like our God this is. When we stumble, when our devotion is interrupted, when we fail even without meaning to, God does not throw us away. He provides a way back. The whole heart of the gospel is that God makes a way for us to be cleansed and restored when we cannot restore ourselves.

For the Nazirite, that way came through the blood of sacrifice. For us, it comes through the blood of Christ. "If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just and will forgive us and purify us from all unrighteousness" (1 John 1:9). Jesus is the once-for-all sacrifice who makes our atonement complete.

If you feel your devotion has been broken, do not despair and do not give up. There is a way back. Come to God through Christ, be cleansed, and begin again.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Have you ever felt your devotion to God was broken?
- How does it comfort you that God always provides a way back?
- Will you come to God for cleansing and a fresh start today?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that when I stumble, You make a way back through Christ. Cleanse me, restore me, and help me to begin again. Amen.
